name: vol_easing_carry_majors
rationale: When realized vol crosses DOWN out of a high-vol regime, the market transitions to a calmer carry regime in which long majors grind higher with low drawdown. Thesis: arm long on vol_realized cross_down (vol regime easing). Disconfirmer: require funding_rate within a modest band — if the edge only works at deeply negative funding it is a funding-reset short-squeeze rather than a vol-easing carry, and if it only works at high positive funding it is momentum; the band isolates the calming effect.
catalyst: realized vol crosses down out of a high-vol regime
